notes.title: Untitled
notes.content:
Completion of Golems and Gnomes is still set for July~ 3 more music tracks, shield gnomes, and a progression sequence of events with NPCs is all that's left to finish in that last few builds~  It's buggy, but it'll be done.

The delay has come from stepping up to fix things at my day job, though that'll be coming to end soon, freeing me up to get back to deving.  Other delays have come from a flooded basement, making my studio unusable for the past 2 weeks.  Luckily none of my equipment was destroyed.

I've also been reviewing Japanese to prepare for passing the N3 by July, and possibly pass N2 by next year.  Besides preparing music and working on coding and 3d modeling, I wanna start preparing for international game jam projects.

Expect updates at the end of May~

notes.title: DECEMBER 1st BETA UPDATE
notes.content: I was not able to get as much done, BUT, the shield gnomes are in as place holders, not fully functional.  More tweaks and changes to the UI are in the horizon~ Getting enough time before the 1st of December was a challenge.  9 missions is the goal~ more gnomes and mini games are next~ followed by an ending sequence after a big boss~  Suggestions are welcome~
